careers.title: Software Developer
careers.description: Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Analyzes data to extract valuable insights using statistics and machine learning.

careers.title: AI/ML Engineer
careers.description: Builds artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions.

careers.title: Cyber Security Analyst
careers.description: Protects systems and networks from cyber threats.

resume_tips: Keep your resume to one page.
Use action verbs like Developed, Built, Designed.
Tailor your resume for each job.
interview_tips: Revise DBMS, OS, OOPs, and Computer Networks.
Practice coding on LeetCode or HackerRank.
Research the company before the interview.

faq.question: Which programming language should I learn first?
faq.answer: Python is beginner-friendly and widely used in AI, automation, and web development.

faq.question: How can I prepare for placements?
faq.answer: Practice DSA, build projects, improve communication skills, and revise core CS subjects.

faq.question: Is AI a good career?
faq.answer: Yes. AI and Machine Learning continue to have strong demand across industries.

faq.question: How do I improve my resume?
faq.answer: Include measurable achievements, projects, internships, certifications, and keep formatting clean.
